visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The host, an Asian male with orange hair and glasses, wearing a black ATDC t-shirt, is filming himself inside a car. He gestures with his right hand while driving. Sunlight streams in from the open sunroof. (2) The camera pans to the backseat where two assistants are sitting. Both are males wearing glasses. One has a tattoo on his arm and a grey t-shirt; the other wears a white t-shirt. They look at the camera. (3) The scene transitions to an outdoor car lot. The host stands in front of a white Skoda Fabia Combi, gesturing towards it with both hands. The background shows other cars and dealership signs under bright daylight. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the white car's front grille and the Skoda logo. The license plate BBD-6216 is clearly visible. The car is parked on a flat concrete surface. (5) The assistants are shown inspecting the car's exterior. One man in a grey shirt uses a handheld digital measuring device on the car's white paintwork while the host watches. (6) The car's hood is opened, and the man in the white shirt leans over the engine bay, using a small flashlight to inspect the components. The host stands nearby, observing and talking. (7) A humorous cut shows the host sitting inside the car's backseat, holding a smartphone and checking the air conditioning vents. He looks surprised when the camera catches him. (8) Close-up shots of the engine bay show hands pointing at the engine mounts and other mechanical parts. The lighting is bright and reveals the textures of the metal and plastic parts. (9) The host is seen crouching next to a black scooter on the street, holding his phone to his ear and talking. He uses animated hand gestures as he speaks to a client. (10) The final scene shows the host standing by the white car again, smiling and waving as he concludes the video. The editing is fast-paced with many jump cuts.
